references.text: Warns against giving what is holy to dogs or casting pearls before swine, similar to Matthew 7:6 which warns against giving the sacred to those who will not appreciate it.

Refers to not calling anyone on earth 'father', for there is one Father, and he is in heaven; this can be seen in connection with Matthew 7:6 regarding evaluating the value of what is holy and to whom it is shared.

Concerning the impossibility of renewing to repentance those who once were enlightened and tasted the heavenly gift but have fallen away, this can be related to the warning in Matthew 7:6 not to cast what is holy to dogs.
